QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is the key piece. In assembly builds it is an empty `asm volatile` that ties `x` to a register. In C builds it returns `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`... The compiler cannot prove the value, so it cannot fold the mask back into a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive hiding values from the compiler and places it in the `library/constant_time_impl.h` section.
